page.overview:
Who is Tony Bonadies?

Tony Bonadies was a United States driver, who failed to qualify for the Indianapolis 500 three times while it was part of the Formula One World Championship. These were his only appearances in Formula One.

Bonadies was killed in a midget race in 1964.
